name: clear_anchor
body:
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Range("A1:C3").UnMerge
Range("A1:C3").Clear
Range("A1").Value = "a"
Range("B1").Value = "b"
Range("C1").Value = "c"
Range("A2").Value = "d"
Range("B2").Value = "e"
Range("C2").Value = "f"
On Error Resume Next
Range("A1:B2").Merge
Range("A1").ClearContents
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n) & "|"
For Each cell In Range("A1:C3")
Report = Report & CStr(cell.Value) & ":" & cell.MergeArea.Address & ";"
Next cell
If IsNull(Range("A1:C3").MergeCells) Then
Report = Report & "Null"
Else
Report = Report & CStr(Range("A1:C3").MergeCells)
End If
Report = Report & "|" & answer
